description: Spec 031 (phase 18, SRD Annex I): the manoeuvre detector of spec 030 retrained with the early-alarm label (detector_onset_rows 12: label 1 only in the first 2 min after a course change begins; quiet rows 0; the rest of a turn unweighted), T2's architecture, from scratch on generator 0.6.0 data with realistic bearing error (seed 241, configs/phase7-ranges.json). Normalisation from this dataset's train split. The evaluation job only commits the model; validation (seed 217) and G6 under rules h (fresh seed 242) follow under a later decision.
